input.command: wc -l README.md && grep -n '^#\|tune' README.md; ls; ls .markdown-lint-on-edit CHANGE-VALIDATION.md DRIFT-CHECK.md 2>&1; grep -rln 'tune' yf/src | head -20
sed -n 1,260p README.md; echo ======; grep -n -i 'tune' yf/src/cli.rs | head -60
sed -n 95,172p README.md; printf '%s\n' ====; grep -n -i 'tune' yf/src/cli.rs | head -80
ls target/*/yf 2>/dev/null; (./target/debug/yf harness tune --help || yf harness tune --help) 2>&1; ./target/debug/yf harness --help 2>&1 | head -30
./target/debug/yf --version; git rev-parse --short HEAD; grep -n -i 'detect\|fan.out\|yes\|default' yf/src/cmd/harness/mod.rs | head -50; ls docs/yf docs | head -50
